sources.title: pockettravel/qwen3-4b-instruct-2507-travel-it-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Offline travel assistant for the Pocket Travel Android app: a LoRA fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, merged and quantized to GGUF Q4_K_M, that answers in Italian, in at most 3 sentences, using only the travel-guide CONTEXT it is given, and says so explicitly when the context does not contain the answer.
